description: Angular component for a round switch widget in Thingsboard UI, handling RPC and data subscriptions, with dynamic sizing and error handling.

classes.name: RoundSwitchSettings
classes.description: Configuration settings for the round switch component.

classes.name: RoundSwitchComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing a round toggle switch with RPC and subscription data handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets up DOM references, event handlers, and calls init().

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and observers on component destruction.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Loads settings, initializes state, and starts data retrieval or subscription.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Adjusts component size and font based on container dimensions.

methods.name: setFontSize
methods.description: Calculates and sets font size to fit within max width.

methods.name: measureTextWidth
methods.description: Measures text width for font size adjustment.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Displays error message and adjusts font size.

methods.name: onValue
methods.description: Triggers RPC update when switch value changes.

methods.name: rpcUpdateValue
methods.description: Sends new value via RPC, manages update state.

methods.name: subscribeForValue
methods.description: Subscribes to data source for switch value updates.

methods.name: onDataUpdated
methods.description: Handles incoming data updates, parses value, updates UI.
